scripts.stage:mediapipe: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const from='node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/wasm';const to='public/mediapipe/wasm';fs.mkdirSync(to,{recursive:true});for(const f of ['vision_wasm_internal.js','vision_wasm_internal.wasm','vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.js','vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.wasm'])fs.copyFileSync(from+'/'+f,to+'/'+f);console.log('mediapipe wasm staged')"
scripts.mutate: node -e "const {execFileSync} = require('node:child_process');const {rmSync} = require('node:fs');for (const scope of require('./stryker.conf.json').mutate) {console.log('=== ' + scope);rmSync('reports/stryker-incremental.json', {force: true});execFileSync('npx', ['stryker', 'run', '--mutate', scope], {stdio: 'inherit'});}"
scripts.check:bundle: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const d='dist/client/assets';if(!fs.existsSync(d))throw new Error('run npm run build first');const bad=[[/drizzle:entityKind/,'drizzle-orm'],[/processEntities/,'fast-xml-parser'],[/wardrobe_items/,'db/schema-core'],[/FIT_EPOCH|fitsdk/,'@garmin/fitsdk']];const hits=[];for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js'))){const t=fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+f,'utf8');for(const [re,name] of bad) if(re.test(t)) hits.push(f+': '+name);}if(hits.length){console.error('server-only code in the client bundle:');for(const h of hits)console.error('  '+h);process.exit(1);}const entry=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>/^index-.*\.js$/.test(x));if(entry.length===0)throw new Error('no entry chunk found');for(const f of entry){const t=fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+f,'utf8');if(/FilesetResolver|vision_wasm_internal/.test(t)){console.error('@mediapipe/tasks-vision is in the ENTRY chunk '+f+' \u2014 it must stay behind its dynamic import');process.exit(1);}}if(!fs.readdirSync(d).some(x=>/vision_bundle/.test(x))){console.error('no mediapipe chunk emitted \u2014 the dynamic import may have been dropped');process.exit(1);}console.log('client bundle clean');"
